rules.meaning: Implement every supplied requirement task in its assigned clause; retain its original text and source line.
Use only declarations, compatible local bindings and read-only environment values supplied by the current model.
Respect declared attribute ownership, association shape, enumeration membership, operation scope and result type.
Construct expressions in the supported OCLTSVM dialect. Do not invent unsupported syntax or change the dialect.
Derive business effects, constants and before/after relationships from the requirement, not CRUD conventions, operation names or model names.
Link each task to an actual expression in the submitted clause. This link establishes structural traceability, not semantic correctness.
Repair only program-authorized candidate regions. Preserve unrelated expressions, requirements, signature, model, rules and evaluation artifacts.

acceptance.behavioral: Source-backed development checks when registered; terminal hidden evaluation never enters repair messages.
acceptance.unknownSemantics: Report unresolved evidence instead of guessing or treating structural traceability as proof.
